assertions.title: Default values applied for unset keys

steps.action: Run `uv run mlx-stack config reset --yes` in isolated MLX_STACK_HOME
Run `config get` for default-quant, memory-budget-pct, litellm-port, model-dir, auto-health-check, openrouter-key
steps.expected: Returns documented defaults for unset keys
steps.observed: Returned int4, 40, 4000, /tmp/mlx-stack-user-testing/foundation-config-deps/models, True, and empty value for openrouter-key

steps.action: Set valid values for default-quant, memory-budget-pct, litellm-port
steps.observed: int8, 60, and 4010 accepted with exit code 0

steps.expected: Invalid values rejected with clear range/type guidance
steps.observed: Each invalid value exited 1 with explicit valid-values/range/integer error text

assertions.title: Corrupt or empty config file handled gracefully

steps.action: Write invalid YAML (`{{{`) to config.yaml and run `config list`
steps.expected: Clear corruption error suggesting reset command
steps.observed: Exited 1 with parse error and explicit `mlx-stack config reset --yes` suggestion

steps.action: Create empty config.yaml and run `config get default-quant`
Remove config.yaml and run `config get memory-budget-pct`

steps.observed: Help output lists get, list, reset, set

steps.expected: Each subcommand displays usage and arguments/options
steps.observed: set/get/list/reset all returned help text with exit code 0

assertions.title: Auto-install of missing vllm-mlx and litellm

steps.action: Run dependency-triggering commands: `uv run mlx-stack up` and `uv run mlx-stack bench fast`
steps.expected: Missing dependencies detected, auto-install invoked, and success verified
steps.observed: Both commands exit 1 with "Not yet implemented" placeholder output

assertions.issues: Cannot validate auto-install flow because `up` and `bench` user-surface commands are not implemented in this milestone build.

assertions.title: Auto-install failure produces clear error with manual instructions

steps.action: Attempt to reach dependency install path via `uv run mlx-stack up`
steps.expected: Install failure path shows failed command and manual instructions
steps.observed: Command exits 1 with "Not yet implemented" before dependency management is reached

assertions.issues: Dependency install failure path is unreachable from CLI because dependency-triggering commands are not implemented.

assertions.title: Read-only commands do not trigger dependency install

steps.action: Run with PATH excluding vllm-mlx/litellm binaries and execute `uv run mlx-stack profile`
steps.expected: Read-only command succeeds without dependency install attempts
steps.observed: `command -v` found neither tool; `profile` still exited 0 and output contained no install/progress messages

assertions.title: Version mismatch detection

steps.action: Attempt to validate mismatch warning via `uv run mlx-stack up`
steps.expected: Warning displayed when installed version differs from pinned version
steps.observed: `up` exits immediately with "Not yet implemented" placeholder output

assertions.issues: Mismatch warning behavior cannot be exercised via CLI until dependency-checking lifecycle commands are implemented.
